main.description: Pregel-style LangGraph pursuit of the BitNest exit-fraud (2025-12 Medium / decripto.org / dehek.com / LinkedIn / TradersUnion reporting) with automatic link-back to case:takahashi-hiroyuki-20260512. Fans out parallel fetches of seed investigative reports, fans out LLM entity extraction per source (or serial when GFTD_LLM_SERIAL=1 for single-GPU local Ollama), correlates operators / wallets / smart contracts / aliases / recovery-scam follow-ups, probes public chain explorers for discovered wallet addresses, and writes edge_malak_target_extends from new entities to existing yabai anchors (bitnest-ex.com / leedsil.com / bitnest.apk / leedsec.com / leeds-securities / jpevaluation.net). Phase 0 keeps RW INSERT in dry-run via live_write=false (default). Phase 1 enables pegel tick emit + RW edge writes after G1+G2 GREEN. Defense-in-depth: edge layer + LangServer gate_input + LangGraph route_extract / route_chain_probe all enforce input validation and Phase 0 live-write guard.

output_dir.description: Absolute path to persist report.md + raw HTML + extractions.json + chain-probes.json + edges-staged.json + MANIFEST.txt. Empty = no filesystem write.

sources.description: Override default seed sources (6 BitNest-specific URLs). Empty = use built-in SEED_SOURCES.

extra_seed_urls.description: Ad-hoc URLs to add to the fetch list (annotated as publisher=adhoc, credibility=0.5).

live_write.description: Phase 1+ only: emit pegel ticks + RW edge writes. Default false. Phase 0 keeps dry-run.

llm_disabled.description: Skip LLM extraction entirely (smoke-test mode: fetch + persist only).

serial_llm.description: Force serial LLM extraction across sources. Required for single-GPU local Ollama. Equivalent to env GFTD_LLM_SERIAL=1.

wallets.description: Count of correlated wallet addresses (chain × address).

edges.description: Edges staged from new entities to Takahashi yabai anchors.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of concat(report + extractions + probes + edges).

credibility.description: Reliability weight 0..1 used in observation confidence.
